name: What is involved in the garage door installation process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the garage door installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The garage door installation process begins with the removal of your old door and its components, including tracks and springs. Next, our technicians prepare the opening and install new tracks, springs, and hardware. The individual door panels are then assembled and securely attached to the tracks. Finally, the garage door opener is installed and programmed, and a thorough inspection and testing are conducted to ensure proper balance, smooth operation, and adherence to all safety standards. We ensure the work area is clean upon completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The installation process involves removing the old door, preparing the opening, installing new tracks and hardware, assembling door panels, and finally installing and testing the garage door opener.
